requirement_text: Article 6 heading: "Niet rechtstreeks toelaatbare vooropleidingen (geen vwo NG met natuurkunde, NT met biologie, NG+NT of buitenlands diploma)" ["Prior educations not directly admissible (i.e. other than: VWO profile NG with physics, NT with biology, combined NG+NT, or a foreign diploma)."] Read together with Article 6.1 ("voor buitenlandse kandidaten: niveau vergelijkbaar met vwo" / "for foreign candidates: a level comparable to VWO"), direct eligibility requires a Dutch VWO diploma with profile Nature & Health (NG) including physics, OR profile Nature & Technology (NT) including biology, OR the combined NG+NT profile, OR — assessed case-by-case via the Admissions Office and OSIRIS — a foreign diploma of a level comparable to VWO.

requirement_text: "Deelnemers die aan alle selectieonderdelen van de selectie hebben deelgenomen én die op basis van de behaalde z-score een rangnummer 200 of lager hebben [worden direct gerangschikt]; de rangnummers 201 en hoger worden via expliciet gewogen loting toegekend... Selectiescore (weging 65%): gemiddelde Z-score gebaseerd op de opdrachten en toetsen van de selectiedag. Randomscore (weging 35%): Een willekeurige score om toeval een rol te laten spelen." ["Participants who took part in all selection components and whose z-score gives them rank 200 or lower are ranked directly on that basis; ranks 201 and higher are assigned via explicit weighted lottery... Selection score (weight 65%): average z-score based on the selection day's assignments and tests. Random score (weight 35%): a random score to give chance a role."]
source_authority_note: eur.nl fails looksOfficial() (no .edu/.ac./.gov suffix) — this is the institution's own official page. Needs the officialDomains-provenance fix documented in source-authority-gap.md, not a lowered evidence bar.
researcher_notes: The best-ranked 200 candidates by pure z-score are admitted directly; the remainder (rank 201+) are admitted via a lottery weighted 65% toward selection-day performance and 35% toward a random draw. This is the specific mechanism behind what EUR's public-facing pages generically call a 'Selection Assessment' / decentralized selection — this reglement is the authoritative source for exactly how it works. Rank numbers are communicated on 15 April via Studielink per Article 12.4 (see companion deadline record).
